summary: NextNRG Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Standard Merchant Cash Advance Agreement with Avanza Capital Holdings LLC on June 30, 2026. Under the terms, NextNRG sold $1,499,900 of future receivables for a $1,000,000 purchase price, netting $940,000 after fees. Remittance is 25% of daily settlements via ACH with a $268,732 monthly cap; no prepayment penalty. The CEO personally guaranteed. This is a financing arrangement, not a special situation event, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change.
